concepts: number of digits in concatenated sequence
problems.notes: Involves constructing a sequence by concatenating numbers from 1 to 1990, then repeatedly removing digits at even/odd positions. Solution tracks positions via arithmetic progressions with doubling differences.
Finds unique point P such that any line through P intersecting parabola y=αx² at A,B yields OA ⟂ OB. Uses vector perpendicular condition and line equation parameter λ.

concepts: order of an integer modulo p
problems.notes: Defines F_n(x) as product of (x^d-1) terms. Shows it's integer polynomial with roots being primitive n-th roots of unity. Uses combinatorial argument to count multiplicities. Part (b) uses order of 2 modulo p and LTE lemma.
Uses known fact: if a1,...,an are coprime, every sufficiently large natural number can be written as x1a1+...+xnan with xi natural. Shows complement M' must have common divisor >1.

Seeks triangle covering given arc with endpoints on one side, minimal area. Shows optimal triangle is isosceles with tangents from endpoints, and legs bisected by points of tangency. Solves via derivative of area function.

concepts: relationship between side lengths and area
problems.notes: Uses inversion to relate tetrahedron ABCM to triangle with sides aa1, bb1, cc1. Derives formula V=σ/(6R). For equilateral base ABC, proves inequality RS ≥ V using d=R√3.
